name: codemesh-agent
description: Paired CodeMesh control/treatment tasks for Codex and compatible agents.

tasks.prompt: Explain how ingestion writes and updates repository registry records. Cite the implementation files and exact line ranges that support the answer.
Explain how deleting an indexed repository cleans graph, content, embeddings, summaries, runs, and registry data. Cite the implementation files and exact line ranges.

tasks.description: Explain refresh and self target resolution.
tasks.prompt: Explain how CodeMesh resolves repository roots and targets for refresh and self-ingestion. Cite the implementation files and exact line ranges.

tasks.description: Repair an incorrect Agent Access context-package endpoint.
tasks.prompt: The typed Agent Access client sends context-package requests to the wrong endpoint. Diagnose and make the smallest correction, then run the relevant validation.
Self-ingestion is leaking a smoke-only Agent Access URL option into normalized ingestion arguments. Diagnose and make the smallest correction, then run the relevant validation.
Repository deletion removes summaries but incorrectly reports that summary cleanup did not complete. Diagnose and make the smallest correction, then run the relevant validation.
